name: Bailey Valdez
life: “I still remember being asked to clean round the workers still using the floor.” On Friday, near Paper & Pine Books, Bailey starts with the handwritten shelf cards and often leaves with a suggestion for somebody else.
voice: I clean before opening. Every extra hour someone wins is an hour somebody else lifts out of a wet bin.
appearance: On an ordinary day, look for a red windbreaker and a watch on a cracked leather band. Bailey has heavy brows and an unusually delicate jaw, with close-cropped dark curls. Bailey gives a little nod before asking a hard question during a conversation.
personality: Bailey feels a room through sound. A door slammed in high spirits can produce the same instant startle as an angry one, and it takes a little while to hear what actually follows.
agenda: To budget hours for cleaning the longer opening.
family: Darcy Wu is Bailey’s half-sibling. Bailey keeps the photographs. Darcy knows which ones can be shared. They enjoy remembering people in public and also know what it feels like to have a private afternoon turned into an anecdote for strangers. Asked about *The driving lesson fund*, Darcy says, “I turned down my slot because I don't want to drive.”
connections: Ariel Pierce. A night bus rider sees the extra cleaning work behind an extra open hour.
